music.prompt: Cinematic sports-commercial track at 120 BPM that builds from intimate to anthemic. For the first eight seconds: a soft, warm synth pulse and sparse piano over a muffled heartbeat kick, with a slowly rising swell. At eight seconds the full beat drops in hard: punchy drums, driving synth bass and bright plucked arpeggios. The energy keeps climbing to an anthemic peak around fifteen seconds and holds strong to twenty-two seconds, then lands on one big final hit at twenty-three seconds that rings out to silence. Instrumental, crisp modern production, uncluttered mids that leave room for a voiceover.

lines.text: [softly] There's a run you're always chasing...
The one where every step feels like... [whispers] nothing at all.
Drops October ninth. Only on the Kite app.

sfx.prompt: A fast, airy whoosh as a running shoe tears past the camera, clean sports-commercial sound design.
A soft, crisp smartphone interface tap.
A quick rising whoosh, like something lifting off a glass screen.
A short, clean digital countdown beep.
A premium foldable phone hinge opening smoothly, ending on a soft mechanical click.
A short smartwatch notification: a soft haptic buzz with a gentle ping.
A cardboard shoe box set down gently on top of another box, a soft muted thud.
A slow, low cinematic camera swoosh.
A short, punchy logo sting: a whoosh into a bright synth hit.
